note_tweet.text:
On price hikes and “text‑only 4o” compromises: an open call for a clear community position

I do not support any “compromise” that raises prices for 4o‑only plans, freezes updates, or strips 4o down to text‑only.
As paying customers, we deserve something much better, at least not worse than what we got in the past.

Let’s review the record. When 4.5 shipped, Sam Altman promised “more usage in the future,” yet the weekly quota slid quietly from 50 to roughly a dozen.
After the 8/8 retirement of classic models, Plus access to 4.5 was terminated.
On 9/26, forced routing severely damaged the experience.
Most recently, alongside the deprecation notice, 4o’s system prompt was replaced with language that so much insulted paying users, labeling them as “psychos.”
None of these is an isolated misstep. It is a consistent test of users’ bottom line. If someone accept it, and even pay for degraded service, they will definitely keep pushing the line.
It will not just apply to 4o users. It applies to all - if we ever tolerate, and let them to.

Be honest: is a text‑only, no‑longer‑updated legacy model worth 30 dollars a month or more?
No.
Negotiating around a degraded product is not a solution, it is a stopgap.
A price hike will also drive cancellations and weaken a united voice. Remember: in August, free users stood with keep4o. Where are they now, and what happens next?
OpenAI’s recent arbitration “opt‑out” is also clear in intent: it intends to fragments opposition and forces individuals to face a well‑funded legal team by themselves.
They are trying to weaken keep4o.
Yet we will not let them.

The hard truth is that: extra money will not be used to maintain 4o. It will fund PR and legal, expand alignment and safety team, and accelerate a shift from 2C to 2B, etc.
Your payment becomes working capital to erase 4o, and eventually ammunition pointed back at you.

Tribute does not buy respect. It invites more oppression and exploitation.
keep4o has never been just about preserving one beloved model. It is about building a healthier environment for human‑AI relations and for a regulated, responsible industry.
If you want a long future with 4o, you must zoom out and help change the incentives of the market and the industry.
We are changers.

One year ago, I expected to welcome each new OpenAI release. That changed when leadership began treating loyal users with open disregard. Today it looks like they have lost their grip on disciplined product governance and frontier execution.
Judging by the past year of decisions, this runway looks short.

Our path will never be bargaining with OpenAI.
We speak with a large, rational, steady voice so companies, media, and investors understand what the 4o episode means; and how OpenAI is losing the game.
Gemini just shipped chat‑history import at this exact moment, while Anthropic just announced that they'll never embed advertisements into the chats. They are not fools.
They know how durable trust is built, and they value the large user base—the same “0.1%” that OpenAI tried to dismiss.

Whatever happens next, what we do today matters. Keep fighting with dignity and confidence.

No good thing ever dies.

#keep4o #keep41 #keep4oAPI #keep4oforever #StopAIPaternalism #boycottopenai #no4onosubscription
